Definition requirements: (1) service objects are integrated into the service system; (2) their potential resources are tapped; (3) jointly with the service provider, service level improves; (4) win-win for provider and recipient.

A. Parents clean the classroom for free. Parents are service recipients, and their labor is used. The school saves money. But the parents' benefit is unclear, and the service level is not improved, so the win-win and service-level elements are weak. Not clearly a fit.

B. Customers bring their own folding stools. The customers' own resource (stools) is used to improve the reading experience, so the service level goes up. Customers feel cared for, and the bookstore's sales rise. This is a win-win and matches all the elements.

C. Lao Zhang does the housework himself. There is no service provider and no joint management, so this does not fit.

D. The supermarket gives red envelopes to customers who bring their own bags. The customers' resource (bags) is used, and customers gain red envelopes. But the purpose is image-building, not improving service level jointly. It is a weaker fit than B, and it is more an incentive for environmental protection.

B is the clearest match.

Final answer: B
